author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Of all the swords forged in Tony Swatton's workshop, his life-size replicas of God of War's Blades of Chaos might be the heaviest. Adam takes a look at three larger-than-life swords Tony built for Man at Arms, including Kratos' iconic blade, Conan the Barbarian's sword, and the massive buster sword from Final Fantasy!

Find Tony Swatton's builds at https://thetonyswatton.com/ and subscribe to his new channel at https://www.youtube.com/@TheTonySwatton 

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
